wholePhysicalScope: The 19-point circular roof matches the known golden dome coordinates and its published 42.10 m exterior circumference. Named OpenStreetMap ways establish the Old Court perimeter, the east Naqqara Khana, west clock range, north iwan and adjoining sanctuary roof boundaries.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the golden tomb dome, the opposing minarets and historic courtyard. Near levels articulate the vaulted iwans and tiled arcades.
limitations: The model represents the standing golden dome and historic Old Court exterior. Adjacent courts, teaching buildings, interiors and the extended modern complex are outside this model.

The dome and court plan are dimensioned. Subdivisions within the selected shrine mass, minaret alignments and court gate heights are estimates. Tile bands are geometric interpretations and no inscriptions or figural artworks are reproduced.
